card.name: Vol. in journal citations
card.fires_on: The word "Vol" (rarely "No") right after a journal or encyclopedia title in a reference, just before the period and volume number.

modes.label: Vol after journal title
modes.description: "Vol" follows a journal name and comma in a bibliography entry.
